title: ADA: An automated detection algorithm of tremor at Mefite d'Ansanto site
author: Panebianco, Serena
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0
materials: This is a set of python (3.7.

steps.title: Run preliminary detection script
steps.instruction: Execute ADA_detection.py with Python 3.7.8 on the continuous recording of the Mefite d'Ansanto array to perform preliminary tremor detection.

steps.title: Process detection results
steps.instruction: Run ADA_detection_processing.py to process the output generated by the detection script.

steps.title: Merge detection catalogues
steps.instruction: Execute ADA_merge_catalogue.py to combine individual detection catalogues into a single dataset.

steps.title: Extract signal parameters
steps.instruction: Run ADA_parameters_extraction.py to compute the RMS ground‑velocity amplitude of the bandpass‑filtered, instrument‑deconvolved signal and calculate the statistical moments (mean, standard deviation, skewness, kurtosis) of the raw signal amplitude distributions in both the time and frequency domains.
